English: Spindle Stand
An open-air stand with makeshift stools where Indo-Aryan weavers begin spinning raw fibers into thread. Welcomes the first artisans to the camp.
Weavers Bench
A sturdy, portable bench providing communal workspace for several weavers. Simple, yet vital for boosting productivity and unity.
Loom Hut
A large, tented hut dedicated to loom-work, sheltering valuable tools and weavers from the elements. Fosters greater horde cohesion and output.
Threading Pavilion
A sprawling pavilion where skilled hands work in tandem, threading fine yarn for cloth production. Increases the efficiency and size of the nomadic horde.
Dyehouse
A permanent structure for dyeing threads and fabrics in vibrant hues, introducing complex techniques and trade opportunities.
Patterned Loom Room
A well-appointed hall filled with advanced looms for intricate patterns, boosting both textile output and the unity of the Indo-Aryan clan.
Fine Weavers Hall
A prestigious hall where master weavers create luxurious textiles for trade and prestige, attracting skilled artisans and increasing clan renown.
Textile Chamber
A grand chamber that organizes large-scale textile production and manages supply lines, further improving the mobility and growth of the horde.
Cloth Guildhall
A fortified guildhall where the most skilled Indo-Aryan weavers and merchants gather, regulating trade and enhancing the hordes prosperity and cohesion.
Indo-Aryan Weaver Guild
The highest seat of Indo-Aryan weaving, this grand guild commands vast resources, secures trade, and cements unity and prosperity for the entire horde.
